title: Strengthen access token and refresh token session-version invalidation
scope: refresh token rows now store the issuing user session_version
refresh flow rejects and revokes tokens when the stored version no longer matches the current user session_version
new refresh tokens inherit the current user session_version so role changes, disables and forced resets close refresh-token race windows
tests cover refresh-token version mismatch, session-version persistence and existing access-token stale-session rejection
remaining: consider adding short-lived operation confirmation tokens for the most sensitive admin actions
